aws-athena:equality-deletes:v2.notes: Not supported as a write operation. Athena's engine (Trino-based) never produces equality delete files for DELETE/MERGE, only positional delete files. Measured 2026-08-27: Spark-created v2 tables mutated by Athena gained positional delete files only. It can read equality delete files written by another engine, but that is a read capability, not this operation.

aws-athena:equality-deletes:v3.notes: Athena does not support Iceberg V3 with S3 Tables

aws-athena:merge-on-read:v2.notes: Supports merge-on-read for both position and equality deletes with S3 Tables

aws-athena:merge-on-read:v3.notes: Athena does not support Iceberg V3 with S3 Tables

aws-athena:copy-on-write:v2.notes: Not supported. Measured 2026-08-27: v2 Iceberg tables created by Spark with write.delete.mode / write.update.mode / write.merge.mode = copy-on-write were mutated by Athena, and Spark inspection of the resulting snapshots showed positional delete files added (1 for DELETE, 2 for MERGE), not a data-file rewrite. Athena ignores the copy-on-write table properties and always uses merge-on-read for DELETE/MERGE.
caveats: MERGE and DELETE always use merge-on-read

aws-athena:copy-on-write:v3.notes: Athena does not support Iceberg V3 with S3 Tables

aws-athena:google-lakehouse:v2.notes: Google Lakehouse exposes a standard Iceberg REST catalog, and this engine speaks the Iceberg REST Catalog protocol, so it can attach to the Google Lakehouse runtime catalog and read/write its tables like any other IRC endpoint. Rated partial because this specific pairing has not been measured end to end and Google-side specifics (credential vending, v3 preview) may vary.
caveats: Inferred from generic Iceberg REST catalog support; not measured against Google Lakehouse specifically

aws-athena:google-lakehouse:v3.notes: Google Lakehouse exposes a standard Iceberg REST catalog, so an engine with REST-catalog support could in principle attach to it, but this specific pairing has not been measured. See the catalogs page for the Google Lakehouse runtime catalog's own capabilities.
caveats: Not yet measured for this engine
